The song that kept "Just the Two of Us" at number two was "Bette Davis Eyes" by Kim Carnes. According to the source [Bette Davis Eyes], Carnes's 1981 version spent nine weeks at No. 1 on the "Billboard" Hot 100. The song was written and composed by Donna Weiss and Jackie DeShannon, as stated in both [New Arrangement] and [Bette Davis Eyes].

Final answer: Robert Sheehan
